svg.title: ऋतम्भरेश्वर मंदिर — Devanagari-led temple lockup (city print)
svg.desc: The temple's city-print voice: Devanagari name large (Tiro), English support line small in letterspaced Cinzel caps with the gold bindu under its leading R, stone hairline between. On the letterhead the hub and this bindu are one gold in two renderings (D1a).
